newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Feb 14.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- World Bank report says need for higher retirement age and less generous pensions. It urges the creation of a pension fund to boost savings, as foreign investments are insufficient.
- State-owned maritime navigation firm COMANAV gave good performance estimated at 34 million dirhams net income in 1996.
- State-owned ONEP water utility considers increasing bills to achieve self-reliance.

- Moroccan businessmen expected in the United States on February 22 to look into trade with American counterparts. The visit has been initiated by the Moroccan-American Council for Trade and Investment.
- Credit body launches campaign for respect for professional ethics.

- French firm Lyonnaise de Eaux, which is expected to take over water and electricity networks in Casablanca, replies to Morocco's opposition critics questioning the deal. The firm plans to invest $1.0 billion over a 30-year concession to upgrade the city infrastructures.
